evidence.title: CAI-DLLM: Convergence Aware Inference for Diffusion Language Models

summary: A new technique called Convergence Aware Inference (CAI-DLLM) aims to improve the efficiency and accuracy of diffusion-based language models. The method optimizes inference by dynamically adjusting convergence criteria during generation.
title: Researchers Introduce CAI-DLLM: A New Inference Method for Diffusion Language Models
